newsitem.title: USA: Empire of Carolina sees net loss for 1996.
newsitem.headline: Empire of Carolina sees net loss for 1996.

text.p: Empire of Carolina Inc said Tuesday it expected to report a net loss for the year due to higher than anticipated manufacturing costs incurred to meet customer demand.

The company said it had incurred "excessive" labor, manufacturing and shipping costs as a result of rapid sales growth. Difficulties in integrating the Buddy L manufacturing facilities and the need to contract out certain production requirements had also risen costs.
The company said shipments made through its Hong Kong office, which represents about 25 percent of sales, would not be affected.
It foresaw break-even operating income and a pre-tax cash flow large enough to cover interest expenses.
Empire of Carolina Inc designs, develops, manufactures and markets a broad range of basic plastic children's toys.
